content.text: from html import escape from urllib.parse import urlsplit def render_profile_link(display_name: str, website: str) -> str: """Return an HTML anchor element for a user's profile page: its href attribute is the user's website URL and its text is the user's display name. """ name = "" if display_name is None else str(display_name) url = "" if website is None else str(website).strip() # Remove control characters and whitespace that browsers may ignore in schemes cleaned = "".join(ch for ch in url if ch >= " " and ch != "\x7f") safe_url = "" try: parts = urlsplit(cleaned) scheme = parts.scheme.lower() except ValueError: scheme = None if scheme in ("http", "https"): if parts.netloc: safe_url = cleaned elif scheme == "": # Relative URLs without a scheme (e.g. "/user/1", "example.com" treated as path) # are allowed only if they cannot be interpreted as another scheme. if cleaned and ":" not in cleaned.split("/", 1)[0]: safe_url = cleaned href = escape(safe_url, quote=True) text = escape(name, quote=True) return f'{text}'
